drivers.theme: AI credit spreads widening / cost of capital repricing
Momentum breakdown after worst Nasdaq day in months, no bounce
Oil spike (Brent ~114) and Iran strike risk post-midterms
Hyperscaler capex earnings + Fed binary risk next week
Rotation into defensives/equal-weight, treasury safe-haven bid
Quality-over-leverage argument: big-cap cash flow winners, near-term buy-the-dip case

parsed.rationale: Credit-driven AI financing scare, no reflexive bounce, oil near $115 and midterm/Iran overhang keep risk skewed down; rotation rather than capitulation and safe-haven Treasury bid limit the damage. Hyperscaler capex and Fed next week are the swing factors.
